data.description: Overview About Business Unit: Powerful predictors of the future - our Analytics team seamlessly blends data science and business intelligence to provide unparalleled foresight for our platform offerings. They turn insights into actionable results for our clients by collaborating with senior team members and staying ahead of market trends, powered by our data assets. By using new-age analytic tools and emerging technologies, the team cultivates a dynamic learning environment for curious minds to thrive. Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. Responsibilities Develop analytical frameworks to answer questions/solve business problems. Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights. Hypothesis testing and reporting statistically significant results Create and present data-driven insights to client/stakeholders, proficient with storytelling from the generated insights Project Management skills with the ability to work independently with minimal support Mentor/hand-hold junior team members on technical/problem-solving aspects Apply multiple algorithms or architectures and recommend the best model with in-depth description to evangelize data-driven business decisions. Structure hypothesis, build thoughtful analyses, develop underlying data models, and bring clarity to identified problems. Create visually compelling dashboards and reports to effectively communicate data-driven insights Effective communication skills to convey complex data insights, ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, high levels of accountability in maintaining data integrity. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Marketing Analytics) 5-8 years of experience in the analytics field; marketing analytics experience preferred Proficiency in Python, SQL and Power BI required. Hands-on experience on Data Science projects, developing Predictive / ML models is highly preferred. Experience in Adobe Analytics and Databricks environment would be a plus Superior analytical and problem solving skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Desirable Qualifications: Advanced degree (Master’s/PhD) in Statistics, Economics or other quantitative discipline Working knowledge of cloud enviornments Additional Information Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we’ve provided marketers from the world’s leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels. Epsilon’s comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world. Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day. People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other. Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals. Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement. Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches. Flexibility: We’ve created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively. Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers. Act with integrity Work together to win together Innovate with purpose Respect all voices Empower with accountability These pillars and values are our foundation—shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose. Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In an AI era, we remain ""Guided By Humanity,"" a phrase that describes our foundational belief that human expertise must remain in the driver's seat, supported by the best processes and technology. With our proprietary capabilities and Publicis Media's industry-leading resources and clout, we create ideas that move people and drive transformative business outcomes for brands. data.title: Senior Creative Strategist
data.description: Company description Influential is an AI social data and conversion technology, as well as a Developer Partner of IBM Watson and a Facebook Marketing Partner. Utilizing a network of over 1,000,000 social media influencers as a tactic for distribution, Influential runs both native and paid campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, Twitter, and YouTube for Fortune 500 brands including Walmart, McDonald’s, Pepsi, Nestlé, General Mills, Toyota, Samsung, Sony Pictures and many more. Influential is the only company that can track deterministic one-to-one in-store foot traffic and sales attribution from paid influencer posts, as well as TV tune-in lift and attribution. Influential is a strategic partner of WME and Oracle’s Moat and has offices in Beverly Hills, New York City, and Las Vegas. (www.influential.co) Overview The Senior, Creative Strategist develops insight-led, creator-first creative ideas that connect culture, creators, and data to real business results across key clients and Publicis Groupe partnerships. This role turns audience, category, and platform insights into clear and compelling creative thinking that supports proposals, briefs, and campaign narratives. Working within the Creative Strategy team, the Senior, Creative Strategist shapes storytelling that is culturally relevant, strategically grounded, and reflective of client goals. They collaborate closely with Strategy, Creator Partnerships, Campaign, and Design teams to bring ideas to life and ensure creative alignment throughout the process. The Senior, Creative Strategist contributes to concept development, supports the writing of influencer briefs, and plays a key role in crafting polished recommendations for internal and client review. Responsibilities Lead creative ideation and concept development across key clients and Publicis Groupe partnerships. Translate data, audience insights, and brand strategy into compliant, culturally relevant creative ideas. Write and refine influencer briefs that inspire creators while maintaining brand clarity and regulatory alignment. Collaborate with Strategy, Creator Partnerships, Campaign, and Design teams to ensure creative alignment and executional excellence. Deliver polished, insight-backed proposals for Associate Director review and support client presentations. Provide mentorship to Creative Strategists, guiding storytelling structure, framework application, and idea development. Manage timelines, communicate risks, and support workflow efficiency in partnership with Creative Operations. Stay current on creator, category, and platform trends to inform new creative approaches and innovation. Qualifications 4+ years in creative strategy, brand storytelling, or influencer/creator marketing. Strong background in developing integrated, data-informed creative concepts. Proven ability to support client proposals and contribute to cross-functional collaboration. Excellent presentation and storytelling skills, both visual and verbal. Deep understanding of social platforms, creator culture, and audience behavior. Experience coaching or mentoring peers in a collaborative team environment. Additional information Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. It means we honor and celebrate all identities, across all facets of intersectionality, and it underpins all that we do as an organization. We are focused on fostering belonging and creating equitable & inclusive experiences for all talent. data.title: Account Director
data.description: Company description Bartle Bogle Hegarty (BBH) is a world-famous creative agency that makes jaw-dropping, thumb-stopping, eye-opening work for brands across the globe. Founded in London in 1982, we now have offices in New York, Los Angeles, Stockholm, Mumbai, Singapore, and Shanghai. Our first ad for Levi’s showed a black sheep travelling in the opposite direction to a flock of white ones. That’s where we got our logo and our guiding philosophy: when the world zigs, zag. Why? Because it’s easy to zig, to go with the grain. It feels safe. It feels like the sensible thing to do. But the greater risk is failing to stand out. We believe in the power of difference to make a difference. Our goal is a simple one: make the best work in the world. That’s where you come in. We need rebels, dreamers, thinkers, mathematicians, makers, artists, visionaries, doers, observers, the different and the unreasonable. We need Black Sheep. People who want to make the hearts flutter and minds do flips, who can change businesses and culture. People who want to make a difference, come here for something different. https://www.bartleboglehegarty.com Overview We are currently seeking a full-time Account Director - Social First to join our team. The Account Director leads the relationship, the work, and the vision across key client businesses, with a deep focus on social‑first brand building. You’ll guide integrated teams to create ideas engineered for culture, built for platforms, and optimized for performance. You’re equal parts strategist, relationship architect, and business driver — shaping the work while shaping the partnership. The account person is the only person in the agency who touches every aspect of a project in some way: from the relationship with the client, to the relationship with the team, from strategy to finance to creative to production. It is ultimately the role of an account person at any level to ensure that a project meets the client and agency’s ambitions to generate great, effective creative work, on time and on budget, and to motivate the team along the way. Responsibilities A business partner to the clients, using their deep knowledge and understanding of the clients’ business in order to create the best conditions for the right work to thrive, leading to the success and growth of both our partners and our agency. Able to manage internal teams (direct reports, colleagues, and seniors) with poise, clarity and integrity building followership across the board, navigating the BBH process effortlessly and are able to lean on the internal expertise available (across offices) to deliver outstanding creative solutions to a range of business problems. Fluent in all phases of the creative process from strategy, through creative to production and bring their expertise to bear at each stage, foreseeing issues before they arise and heading them off. Taking pressure off the team by tackling the difficult conversations and know when to escalate for support is also part of their role. Own the client relationship as the primary strategic partner, ensuring trust, clarity, and forward momentum across all workstreams. Drive the social‑first brand strategy, helping clients understand how culture, platforms, and audience behavior shape the creative. Partner with Creative, Strategy, and Production to deliver work that is native to TikTok, Reels, YouTube, and emerging platforms — not retrofitted from traditional campaigns. Oversee day‑to‑day account operations, ensuring teams are aligned, resourced, and delivering against timelines and KPIs. Translate business challenges into clear briefs, actionable insights, and platform‑specific creative opportunities. Qualifications 7+ years in account management within advertising, social, or digital agencies. Deep fluency in social platforms, creator ecosystems, cultural trends, and content formats. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and run multiple projects at once with minimal oversight A solid understanding of business and marketing strategy Experience leading integrated teams and complex client relationships. Strong strategic instincts — able to connect brand, audience, and platform behavior into actionable direction. Comfort with fast‑moving, iterative work cycles and real‑time content environments. Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to simplify complexity and inspire confidence. A collaborative leadership style that elevates teams and builds trust with clients. data.title: [Contracting] Senior CRM Strategist
data.description: Company description Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value. Overview As a Senior CRM Strategist, you will support enterprise CRM transformation initiatives by designing, optimizing, and scaling lifecycle strategies across regulated, multi‑market environments. This role sits within a consultative delivery model, working closely with senior CRM leads, technical teams, and global stakeholders. Your Impact Support the assessment and optimization of existing CRM platforms (e.g., Optimove, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze). Design and refine lifecycle frameworks (onboarding, engagement, retention, reactivation). Execute and optimize CRM journeys across channels (email, push, SMS, WhatsApp). Support data hygiene, segmentation logic, and campaign QA. Collaborate with designers, email developers, and senior CRM strategists to deliver high‑quality CRM outputs. Contribute to test‑and‑learn initiatives (A/B testing, experimentation frameworks). Support multi‑market CRM execution while respecting local regulatory nuances Qualifications Skills & Experience 5+ years of hands‑on CRM or lifecycle marketing experience. Experience working with CRM / Marketing Automation platforms such as: Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Optimove, HubSpot, and Adobe Campaign. Strong understanding of: Lifecycle marketing principles Segmentation and personalization Campaign execution and QA Comfortable working with data concepts (attributes, events, basic SQL or segmentation logic). Experience collaborating in cross‑functional teams (CRM, design, tech, analytics). Ability to clearly explain CRM logic and campaign decisions Advance English Set Yourself Apart With Experience supporting CRM programs in regulated industries. Exposure to multi‑market or global CRM programs. Strong attention to detail and structured execution mindset. Curiosity and learning mindset toward new CRM platforms and tools. Prior experience in consulting or agency environments. Additional information An inclusive workplace that promotes diversity and collaboration. Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Flexibility to support work-life balance. Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family. Generous paid leave and holidays. Wellness program and employee assistance. As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com

data.title: Manager, Commerce Media
data.description: Company description Digitas is the Networked Experience Agency, built on the vision that we create magnetic experiences that earn the right for brands to exist in human networks. Today, and tomorrow. We deliver Networked Experiences by leveraging comprehensive data, technology, creative, media and strategy capabilities. Digitas delivers ambitious outcomes via unique solutions that include Creative Experiences, Integrated Media, Addressable Relationships, Social Marketing and Total Commerce. Celebrated by AdAge as Data and Insights Agency of the Year, U.S Campaign’s Brand Experience Agency of the Year, Media Network of the Year and celebrated by Forrester and Gartner, Digitas serves the world’s leading brands through a global network comprised of more than 5,500 employees across over 65 offices in 43 countries. The Digitas culture is made up of fearless, inventive and generous Unicorns of all kinds. Overview Manager, Precision Commerce Media Digitas is The Connected Marketing Agency, committed to helping brands better connect with people through Truth. Connection. Wonder. Digitas’ world-class Precision Commerce team leverages comprehensive data, technology, creative, media and strategy capabilities to deliver connected solutions. The team is is responsible for digital media activation in this increasingly addressable world, including retail media, display, video, mobile, social, and loyalty. With a deep understanding of media platforms, data, and targeting strategies and razor-sharp analytical skills, our Precision specialists deliver optimal solutions that drive our clients’ business forward. We’re looking for an outstanding Manager—someone who can win the hearts of clients, inspire their teammates, and skillfully juggle multiple pieces of business. This is a unique opportunity for an experienced digital media star to actively drive performance for some of the largest brands on the planet. In this role, you can make a real difference in our clients’ business and our own. Responsibilities As a Manager, you’ll be responsible for oversight of analysts and senior analysts on a day-to-day basis. You will ensure your analysts are properly equipped to handle tasks such as campaign management activities, including campaign setup, optimization and maintenance, QA, performance reporting, and billing reconciliation. You will also play a role in all of these areas ensuring that campaigns are set up properly according to best practices, providing final QA and confirming all aspects of a campaign are running smoothly. You’ll provide feedback on optimization recommendations from analysts when needed and help guide their development in this area. You will provide input in the construction of client decks and status documentation. You will be responsible for the growth and development of analysts on the team and will provide feedback to ADs and above on developmental progress and any needs of the team. You will work within the full Commerce team to report results and foster client and vendor relationships. Most importantly, you must possess a strong inner drive to bring your knowledge and experience of managing self-service display and full funnel campaigns across retailers and retail media networks. Campaigns include hands-on self-serve as well as direct buys with retailers including, but not limited to: Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Kroger, Target, Walgreens, CVS, etc. Qualifications Four or more years of experience in display and video media buying In depth understanding of media planning and programmatic buying, and familiarity with The Trade Desk or similar buying platforms Strong familiarity with the digital environment and a clear understanding of media planning and buying process (multi-channel knowledge and Walmart, Criteo, Target, Amazon, Kroger, etc. display experience preferred) Two or more years of people management experience Strong knowledge of DSP platforms and active campaign optimization experience The ability to organize and manage your work and that of the junior staff on the team Strong analytical thinking and mathematical/quantitative skills Strong understanding of research tools – you know their strengths/weaknesses, and when and how to effectively use them (i.e., Profitero, Epsilon, Scintilla, Comscore, Circana, etc.) Understanding and experience with campaign automation tools (i.e., Skai, Pacvue) Excellent client presence and ability to lead discussions with internal and external leadership Excellent communication and writing skills—you’re poised, precise, and above all, kind when relating to others A four-year college degree Additional information Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. It means we honor and celebrate all identities, across all facets of intersectionality, and it underpins all that we do as an organization. We are focused on fostering belonging and creating equitable & inclusive experiences for all talent. Publicis Groupe provides robust and inclusive benefit programs and policies to support the evolving and diverse needs of our talent and enable every person to grow and thrive. Our benefits package includes medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401K, as well as parental and family care leave, family forming assistance, tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off. Compensation Range: $81,225 - $129,987. This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. Temporary roles may also qualify for participation in our 401(k) plan after eligibility criteria have been met. For regular roles, the Company will offer medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off. The Company anticipates the application deadline for this job posting will be 06/21/2026. If you require accommodation or assistance with the application or onboarding process specifically, please contact USMSTACompliance@publicis.com. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

data.description: Company description Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value. Overview Product Manager with expertise in Organ Transplantation Data and Ecosystem As a Product Manager at Publicis Sapient, you act as your clients’ trusted advisor in leading the overall vision, strategy, roadmap, and prioritization for a specific digital product, or products, within an engagement. You will collaborate with clients undertaking major Digital Business Transformation (DBT) engagements to understand their business, end-customer needs, and then constantly deliver value with fast increment cycles. Experience in digital product management or working with Agile development teams. Knowledge of Lean principles and Agile scaling frameworks. Exposure to customer-centric product development and user experience design. An inclusive workplace that promotes diversity and collaboration. Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Flexibility to support work-life balance. Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family. Generous paid leave and holidays. Wellness program and employee assistance. data.title: Senior Architect Salesforce - Senior Manager
data.description: Company description Publicis Sapient est une entreprise technologique qui fournit des plateformes et services d'IA d'entreprise. Forts de plus de 30 ans d'expérience en transformation digitale des entreprises, nous accompagnons nos clients pour transformer leur fonctionnement et leur façon de servir leurs clients, créer de nouvelles opportunités de valeur et leur permettre de prospérer à l'ère de l'IA. Nos plateformes Sapient Slingshot, Sapient Bodhi et Sapient Sustain mobilisent l'IA, enrichie de nos expertises métiers, pour accompagner les entreprises dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes technologiques existants, la création de solutions agentiques et l'automatisation de leurs opérations informatiques. La combinaison de nos plateformes IA et de l'expertise de nos équipes nous permet de délivrer des résultats plus rapides et plus efficaces. Nos solutions s'adaptent aux besoins uniques de nos clients, de leurs secteurs et de leurs propres clients. Publicis Sapient est le pôle technologique de Publicis Groupe, réunissant 20 000 personnes dans 28 pays. Pour plus d'informations : publicissapient.fr. Overview En tant qu’Architecte Senior spécialisé dans la plateforme Salesforce Core, vous serez responsable de la conception et de la mise en œuvre de solutions performantes et évolutives exploitant pleinement les capacités de la plateforme Salesforce. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les parties prenantes métiers, les Product Owner et les équipes de développement afin de garantir que les solutions Salesforce sont bien alignées avec les objectifs business et délivrent un maximum de valeur. Vous jouerez également un rôle clé dans les activités presales, en apportant votre expertise technique pour soutenir le développement commercial et contribuer à la conquête de nouveaux projets. Votre impact Piloter l’architecture et la conception des solutions Salesforce, en veillant à ce qu’elles soient évolutives, sécurisées et alignées sur les objectifs métier. Collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour recueillir et analyser les besoins métier et les traduire en solutions techniques. Assurer le leadership technique et l’accompagnement des équipes de développement, en veillant à ce que les bonnes pratiques soient respectées dans le développement Salesforce. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des intégrations entre Salesforce et d’autres systèmes d’entreprise, en garantissant un flux de données fluide et l’automatisation des processus. Optimiser les configurations et personnalisations Salesforce pour améliorer les performances et l’expérience utilisateur. Rester informé des nouvelles fonctionnalités et meilleures pratiques Salesforce, et s’assurer qu’elles sont utilisées efficacement par l’organisation. Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des parties prenantes métiers et technologiques, en les aidant à comprendre les capacités et les limites de la plateforme Salesforce. Garantir le respect des standards de sécurité et de gouvernance Salesforce. Contribuer aux activités presales de bout en bout : analyse des RFP/RFI, conception de solutions, chiffrage et cadrage, rédaction de propositions commerciales en collaboration avec les équipes commerciales. Qualifications Minimum 10 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel et architecture, dont au moins 5 ans d'expérience sur Salesforce, idéalement dans un environnement conseil. Excellente connaissance de la plateforme Salesforce Core, incluant Sales Cloud, Service Cloud et Experience Cloud. Solide connaissance des outils et technologies de développement Salesforce, incluant Apex, Lightning Web Components et Visualforce. Expérience avérée dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions Salesforce complexes, incluant des intégrations avec des systèmes externes. Solide compréhension des bonnes pratiques de sécurité et de gouvernance Salesforce. Expérience de travail en environnement Agile et dans la direction d’équipes pluridisciplinaires. Expérience significative en avant-vente : rédaction de propositions commerciales, réponses à appels d'offres (RFP/RFI), chiffrage et estimation de projets Salesforce de bout en bout. Excellente maîtrise de la communication et du stakeholder management, avec une aptitude à traduire des problématiques techniques complexes pour des audiences non techniques. Les certifications Salesforce Certified Application Architect ou Salesforce Certified System Architect sont un atout. Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais à un niveau courant/professionnel Vous ferez la différence avec : Une expérience Salesforce Industries (anciennement Vlocity) ou d’autres solutions Salesforce spécifiques à un secteur. Une connaissance des fonctionnalités Salesforce AI, telles que Einstein Analytics et Einstein AI. Une expérience avec Salesforce DX et les pipelines CI/CD pour le développement Salesforce. Additional information Pourquoi nous rejoindre? Intégrer un cabinet alliant l’excellence stratégique des grands cabinets de conseil et l expertise technologique d’un leader de la transformation digitale Travailler sur des projets à fort impact business, à l’ère de l’IA Évoluer et apprendre dans un environnement collaboratif, entouré d’experts en Stratégie, Produit, Experience, Engineering, Data & AI – un terreau idéal pour se challenger et construire des compétences durables et variées Intégrer une équipe à taille humaine au sein de Publicis, c’est allier l’agilité d’un plus petit cabinet et la puissance et les ressources d’un groupe du Profiter du programme Work Your World, permettant de travailler à distance dans toute la France et à l’étranger jusqu’à 6 semaines consécutives, à partir d’un an d’ancienneté Accéder à de nombreuses formations, certifications, e-learning accessibles gratuitement, coachings, communautés de pratique Accéder à une gamme de produits IA pour la réalisation des tâches du quotidien Recevoir un plan de data.title: Vice President, Strategy
data.description: Company description Publicis Media harnesses the power of modern media through global agency brands Publicis Collective, Spark Foundry, Starcom and Zenith. A key business solution of Publicis Groupe, Publicis Media’s digital-first, data-driven global practices deliver client value and drive growth in a platform-powered world. It is present in more than sixty countries with over 23,000 employees worldwide. Overview We are looking for an exceptionally talented Vice President, Strategy to oversee Media Planning and Strategy functions for a high-profile and fast-paced technology account. This person will lead a team in the development, execution, and stewardship of integrated media plans for the client’s business. The VP effectively leverages experience, curiosity, knowledge, and skills to push fresh thinking while balancing client, agency, and team needs – both short- and long-term. This position report directly to the SVP, Strategy. Responsibilities Role Objectives: Serves as senior lead on client’s business and oversees all aspects of the assigned LOB(s) Defines high level strategy and holistic management of the media plan development, implementation, and execution Identifies key target insights based on client brief necessary for formulating strategic recommendations, and ensures alignment into broader long-term goals Responsible for designing and managing projects and resources for subsidiaries/business unit Maintain an in-depth knowledge of the client business and competitive landscape Team leader for client interaction while fostering positive relationships Ensure teams adopt best in class tools, techniques, and systems to deliver plan recommendations aligned to client’s objectives and expected business outcomes Demonstrate an intimate, and strategic, understanding of how consumers interact with channels and technology, while championing across internal agency teams Outlines role & responsibilities for the Strategy team – delivering on vision, direction, management, and support to direct and indirect reports Supervising, training and developing staff (team growth and learning agenda, managing workload, delegating responsibilities, and performance management) Ensure connectivity with all relevant internal and external stakeholders Serves as primary leadership and content development stakeholder for all client presentations Participation in special projects involving cross department team development and leadership Participates in new business efforts including development of new business opportunities and new business pitches (as needed) Qualifications B.A. or B.S., preferably in Marketing, Advertising, or related field 10+ years of media planning experience 5+ years of experience in a management capacity Agency experience highly preferred Experience in entertainment is a big plus Proven experience and success in presenting plans to senior clients and influencing top level client decisions related to media strategy and implementation Excellent leadership, management and motivational skills Excellent organizational, interpersonal and quantitative/analytical skills Adept at injecting ideas, innovation and leading industry developments into planning assignments Detail-oriented and proven ability to thrive in a fast paced environment Must be a self-starter, with strong planning and organizational skills Computer Skills/Software Knowledge: Microsoft Suite, Nielsen Suite, Kantar, IMS, Flowchart Software, R/F and Optimization Software, Social Tracking tools, comScore, Prisma, Mbox, MRI/GfK, GWI. Understand its capabilities and applications to translate data into actionable insights Thinks clearly and diplomatically when participating in a discussion to field complex or sensitive questions from clients/internal groups Professional presentation, training and client-facing skills Excellent written/verbal communication, presentation, organizational, interpersonal and analytical skills Accountability and flexibility with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment Demonstrates ability to define and implement professional standards for team participation, conflict resolution, problem solving, and communication Able to guide others in defining high level strategy for business unit Able to manage a budget, control costs, plan and schedule around cost concerns for business unit Demonstrates an ability to be curious and passionate about our client’s business Positive, team-player attitude Additional information Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. It means we honor and celebrate all identities, across all facets of intersectionality, and it underpins all that we do as an organization. We are focused on fostering belonging and creating equitable & inclusive experiences for all talent. Publicis Groupe provides robust and inclusive benefit programs and policies to support the evolving and diverse needs of our talent and enable every person to grow and thrive. Our benefits package includes medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401K, as well as parental and family care leave, family forming assistance, tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off. If you require accommodation or assistance with the application or on-boarding process specifically, please contact USMSTACompliance@publicis.com. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Veterans Encouraged to Apply Compensation Range: $159,695-$195,000. This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. Temporary roles may also qualify for participation in our 401(k) plan after eligibility criteria have been met. For regular roles, the Company will offer medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off. The Company anticipates the application deadline for this job posting will be 7/13/2026. #LI-EH1
